beats.say: P equals P nought E to the power K T. It starts at one hundred and doubles every seven point five hours.
Starts at one hundred means T equals zero. So P nought is one hundred.
Doubling means P is two hundred. Put T equals seven point five into the model.
P is two hundred, not two. Doubling doubles the starting value.
Divide both sides by one hundred, so the E part stands alone. E to the power seven point five K equals two.
Take L N on both sides, because E is involved. L N E is one, so seven point five K equals L N two.

do.text: ← ln is used because e is involved

beats.say: Divide by seven point five. K equals L N two over seven point five, about zero point zero nine two four.

do.on: zero point zero nine two four
